text: The attached tracking form has been designed for use with test panel
stores selected for retail audits. A complete listing of the 30 test
panel stores has also been included for your use.
• The form should be completed upon each contact to a test panel
The quantity sold or exchanged-in of any Rio packing should be
properly recorded. Gratis should be included in the quantity
In the case of an exchange the quantity and specific packings
• 2 for 1 promotional displays should reflect total product sold
(include complimentary packs and gratis) and quantity listed on
form should be noted as a 2 for 1 promotion.
Forms should be mailed on a daily basis, whenever contact to
panel stores occurs, to the address listed at the bottom of each
Test panel stores need be contacted during the first couple of
days of retail coverage, allowing the auditors to begin measuring
